target_customer: Enterprise business teams in sales, ops and HR
problem: Business teams want to automate knowledge work without engineering help or complex workflow builders.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent platforms were becoming standard on top of LLM APIs; reliability and integrations are the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third party models with many similar entrants.

market_need_then: The early product was pitched as Perplexity for consultants (YC launch); demand evidence not opened.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with an unrelated Singapore consulting firm; no brand coverage.

pivots.from: AI market research for consultants, 'Perplexity for Consultants'
pivots.to: agentic operating system and AI employees for the enterprise

outcome_analysis: Dataleap started as an AI research tool for consultants and now sells an agent platform for enterprise business teams. It raised a pre-seed in September 2024 of undisclosed size. Traction is not documented in reliable sources, and the market is crowded, so the outcome is still unknown.
notes: Funding totals conflict across aggregators (130K, 500K, 850K, 3.5M, 3.9M); the pre-seed amount is not stated, so amount_usd is null. Pre-seed seen on nordic9 only; aggregators list the same investors. Pivot date not known. Website fetch returned only the title. No dated competitor list or naming story found. Outcome search found nothing about the company.
